mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST declines by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous month signals a shift in demand composition, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase and RSAFS decrease in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where PAYEMS increases and RSAFS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a simultaneous increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases.
